title: Bullying and Cyberbullying Are Associated with Inappropriate Use of the Internet, Cell Phones, and Video Games in Children and Adolescents.
authors: Moral-García JE, Rusillo-Magdaleno A, Patiño-Villada FA, Martínez-López EJ.
figures: Association of victimization and perpetration in bullying and cyberbullying with respect to internet use.
Association of victimization and perpetration in bullying and cyberbullying with respect to cell phone use.
Association of victimization and perpetration in bullying and cyberbullying with respect to the use of video games.
tables: Biometric characteristics; sociodemographic data of participants; average MVPA; bullying and cyberbullying variables; and Internet, cell phone, and video game use segmented by sex.

Odds ratio (OR) and confidence intervals (95% CI) for levels of victimization/perpetration in bullying and cyberbullying. Internet, cell phone and video game use were included in the logistic regression as a categorical variable (low vs. high). The OR was adjusted for age, body mass index, mother’s educational level and average weekly physical activity.
